difficulty_reason: H3: recognizing the entire finite complex level-zero representation span from character germs requires both analytic and spectral reductions. The forward direction must extend the compact-mod-center W2 formula to all p-prime neighborhoods through a proper Levi, a Casselman Jacquet character comparison and semisimple-rank induction. The reverse direction separates central characters and real unramified twists, reconstructs elliptic cuspidal data using the density/bijection bridge, and eliminates all positive-level spectral components through the graded-annihilator decomposition. The full new representation-side proofs and all nonroutine prior distribution-realization core are supplied; the result is not inferred merely from arbitrary quasi-character realization.
